reasoning: A five-pointed star with a cheerful smiling face inside directly evokes gold-star stickers, kids' reward charts, kudos, and positive five-star reviews. It fits a narrow but very real slice of parenting, teaching, and customer-review tasks, and the face clearly distinguishes it from a plain bookmark/favorite star.
